name: @ryntra/evidence
description: The market-evidence layer a Trading Plan's conditions stand on: a metric registry, a normalized observation with its provenance and times, a condition validator and judge where an unjudgeable rule is never a pass, a rights map read from the provider's terms, a credit-governor contract, and the Nansen adapter that reserves and settles every call. Pure modules plus one thin HTTP client; no storage, no signing.
author: Dmytro Plavutskyi
